comparisons.weights: byte_identity compares the streamed FP8 load with the reference FP8 load of the same model, tensor by tensor; the 9B reference loaded BF16 and ran Karpo's quantize

gpu: NVIDIA L4 (us-east4, Cloud Run job, 16 GiB host limit for streaming runs)
note: Tensor digests are SHA-256 of the raw bytes of every backbone state_dict tensor (FP8 weights and scales included) and the readout, so identity is claimed for weights, not for answers. 12B answers moved between container runs with identical weights; the cause was not isolated.
